utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Huge. Thank you, Alex.

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: Announcement goes out at noon.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Let's do a retro for 4.2 next week. Tuesday the 27th at 11?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Works for me.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Can you collect the QA learnings? Stuff like the staging outage, sandbox timeouts.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Sure. I'll put together a QA learnings doc before the retro.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I'll add the auth stuff to it.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Tested the Safari fix on Mac and iPad. No logouts after two hours idle.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Yesss.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: One thing: the refresh token rotates twice on wake. Harmless, but can you look?

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I'll look at the double rotation early next week.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Thanks. From my side it's a yes for 4.2.1.

utterances.speaker: Carla
utterances.text: Hi Alex, did you get the renewal documents? I emailed them Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I did, sorry. It's been release week.

utterances.speaker: Carla
utterances.text: No worries, just a reminder they're due the 30th.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'll sign them this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Carla
utterances.text: Thank you!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: That's the last box. I can't feel my arms.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Same. Your couch weighs as much as a car.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Pizza's here. Stay for a slice?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: One slice, then I need to shower and get the cake.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Thank you so much, seriously. I owe you dinner.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'll take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Best birthday. The cake was perfect.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Mom picked the flavor, I just carried it.

utterances.speaker: Mom
utterances.text: You were on time, too. I'm impressed.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Told you I would be.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Next year I want the same cake.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: At Costco. Rice, coffee, paper towels. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Dish soap. And get the big olive oil.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Total is $86.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'll send you $43 when you're back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Cool.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: First Monday after 4.2. Anything on fire?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Two support tickets, both the Safari issue. Expected.

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: Customers are happy about the new search.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Great. Alex, can you start the Playwright pilot this week now that the budget is approved?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Yes. I'll set up the Playwright repo and convert the login suite by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Perfect. Keep it small.

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Sunday run this week? Let's do the canal path, 6 miles.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Six? I'll try. Can we start at 7:30 instead of 7?

utterances.speaker: Chris
utterances.text: Sure. Sunday the 1st, 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Okay, I'll meet you at the canal path at 7:30 Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Okay, retro. What went well?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Triage discipline. We made the Safari call early instead of panicking.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Early test access helped a lot.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: What could be better?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Staging reliability. We lost a whole day. I'd like a staging health check before every test cycle.

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: I can work with ops on that.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Action items then. Omar owns staging health checks. Alex, you'll write the test-cycle entry checklist?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Yes, I'll write the test-cycle entry checklist by next Wednesday.

seed_commitments.action_text: Write the test-cycle entry checklist

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Okay, I owe you dinner. Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Thursday's good. Where?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: That Thai place on Mill?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Perfect. 7?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: 7. My treat, no arguing.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Ha, fine. See you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Hygienist
utterances.text: All done. Everything looks great, one small spot to watch.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Should I come back sooner?

utterances.speaker: Hygienist
utterances.text: Let's do six months. We'll send a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Okay. Should I book now?

utterances.speaker: Hygienist
utterances.text: You can book online anytime.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'll book it online this week.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: How's the pilot going?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Repo's set up. Login suite is 60 percent converted.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Any surprises?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Our test IDs are inconsistent. I might need Nina to add data-testid attributes.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I can add them to the login pages tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Then I should still make Friday for the login suite.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: Should we do the zoo or Balboa Park?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Both? They're right next to each other.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: True. Who's driving?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I'll drive, I have the car now.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'll make a shared itinerary doc tonight and put the Airbnb details in it.

utterances.speaker: Jordan
utterances.text: Organized Alex is my favorite Alex.

utterances.speaker: Carla
utterances.text: Got your signed documents, thank you! You're renewed through November next year.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Great, thanks Carla.

utterances.speaker: Carla
utterances.text: Rent will be $1,575 starting December 1st.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Got it. Have a good weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Are we doing candy this year? Last year we got like three kids.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Let's get one bag. If nobody comes, we eat it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Strong plan. Also there's a horror double feature at the IMAX tonight.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Ooh. What time?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'm in. I'll buy the tickets now.
